thread:
sara (customer-success): Heads up — Franklin's onboarding index hasn't completed after last night's embedding backfill. Their customer success lead says their kickoff demo tomorrow could be impacted. Need a short, customer-friendly status + RCA and a mitigation/credit we can offer.
amanda (cs lead): Short + empathetic. Include ETA and a simple next-step for the customer. Don't be too technical.
jon (eng): RCA (plain): last night's reindex removed an internal safety throttle, which allowed too many concurrent shard workers. One EU node experienced transient disk pressure and retries created a backlog for a small subset of tenants. Immediate actions: paused the global backfill, killed retrying workers, cleared cache on the affected node, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. Longer term: we'll reintroduce the safety throttle and add disk-pressure alerts.
mike (ops): Status/ETA: paused at 02:10 UTC, resumed at 04:30 UTC at ~30% throughput. Franklin's tenant is currently in progress; projected completion ~12-18 hours. If Franklin needs demo-ready state sooner we can run a prioritized targeted reindex (~1-2 hours) upon CS request; ops will expedite.
amanda (cs lead): Draft note to Franklin (keeping it short):

"Hi <Franklin team>,

Quick update from Redwood: during a scheduled indexing job last night, a recent change inadvertently removed a safety throttle which caused retries on an EU node and slowed completion for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the job, fixed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

Status & ETA: your project is reindexing now and we expect completion within ~12-18 hours. If you need the data ready for tomorrow's demo, reply here and we will run a prioritized expedited reindex that finishes in ~1-2 hours; we will cover the cost for trial customers.

Compensation: as an apology we've applied one week of complimentary Dedicated credits to your account.

If you'd like a direct walkthrough, we can schedule a 1:1 with engineering and CS.

Apologies for the disruption — Sara (Customer Success)"

sara (customer-success): That looks good. Jon — is "safety throttle" wording OK? We want to avoid config details but be accurate.
jon (eng): Yes, that's a good high-level phrasing.
amanda (cs lead): I'll send this to Franklin and cc sara + jon. Also updating the internal customer-health tracker: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=12-18h, Compensation=1 week Dedicated credit, Owner=amanda.
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0718 — EU embedding backfill overload. Severity: P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0718
mike (ops): Note: if Franklin requests the expedited run, confirm in-channel and ops will start warm-path reindex immediately.
sara (customer-success): Agreed. Hold off on warm-path until Franklin asks. Amanda, please paste the outgoing message here when sent and log any reply. If completion slips past 20h or we see new 5xx spikes, escalate to P2.
amanda (cs lead): Message sent to Franklin and pasted below. I'll track replies in this thread. :thumbsup
